overview.text:
Pondicherry, officially Puducherry since 2006, sits on the south-east coast about 170 km from Chennai. It was the capital of French India and only legally joined India in 1963, and with Karaikal, Mahe and Yanam it now forms a Union Territory. Incredible India calls it the French Riviera of the East.

The French past is clearest in White Town, where cobbled streets with names like Rue Dumas and Rue Suffren are lined with yellow houses, heritage hotels and cafes. The seafront promenade fills at sunrise and sunset, past the French War Memorial and the 1855 church of Notre Dame des Anges. The Sri Aurobindo Ashram, founded in 1926, draws visitors from around the world, and Auroville's experimental township is about 8 km away. Food mixes croissants and dosa, French cafes and fresh seafood.
